title: Sejunct
html_source: Rare term from Latin meaning separate or separated. From seiunctus, past participle of seiungo (“separate”); from se (“without”) + iungo (“to join”). Related terms are sejunction and sejoin. Compare “conjunction”, “conjunct”, “conjoin”, etc.
